# Genuine V0.5 fixture provenance

Captured on 2026-10-25 before any V0.6 engine/schema changes.

- `v0.5-chapter.json`: original desktop complete-route export from
  `test-results/v05-network-holds-fixed/calendar-K01-11-genuine-V0-193bd-complete-chapter-on-desktop/desktop-v05-save.json`.
  SHA-256: `e881112542e848638db494b71158d71a396fce2b6556c4b047534afcd072e59c`.
- `v0.5-prepared.json`: original export `desktop-prepared-order.json` in the
  same directory. It holds a complete rain order, with O01 active.
  SHA-256: `1d3adef9c826e303da3e6cbfe5e8da95213e47dc734ba8f04483ff4f869973f5`.

Only trailing newlines are normalized. No version, economy, population,
progress or reward is relabeled or filled. The released decoder validates both.

`scripts/v05-reference.mjs` extracts game sources from the exact published
commit `3c094d77143da019cc5b6b756cb120131874f8b3` into a task-owned temporary
directory, bundles them, validates the source files, advances 86,400,517ms,
and runs the original invariant checker. It records each source SHA-256, fixture
digest, complete state and return report in `v0.5-offline-reference.json`.
It removes its temporary extraction after preserving the expectation.

`v0.5-in-transit.json` derives from the genuine prepared export by exactly one
ordinary released-engine action: outbound rain dispatch of one normal package.
It therefore combines a real in-transit shipment, a held calendar order and
an active outpost without manufactured resources. Its digest and separate
24-hour-plus-517ms expectation are recorded in the reference's `boundary`.
Run `node scripts/v05-reference.mjs` under the supported Node version to reproduce.
Current V0.6 code is never used to generate these expected states or reports.
